name: toggle-group
useFor: Use for a choice among a few options that changes what is shown next (Where does this agent run? Hermes, Openclaw, Codex, Claude Code). Use type single for one choice, multiple for several. Put a 24px logo tile or a 20px glyph before each label. Use variant outline for separate keys.
constraints: More than seven choices in one track
source: Figma 427:2715: Where does this agent run? in Modal - Created
title: Toggle Group
description: The segmented choice: a lilac track of 38px choices where the chosen one is a white key with Shadow/S.
